programmes.name: Shell V+
programmes.headline: 15c/litre at Regular; up to 50c/litre
programmes.condition: Higher tiers need repeated fuel fills and qualifying shop spending. Use the tier you already hold.

programmes.name: BP Rewards + Smart Shopper
programmes.headline: Up to 30c/litre combined
programmes.condition: Swipe both cards. BP Rewards supplies 20c/litre; Smart Shopper adds its separate reward. Discovery Insure and Smart Shopper cards cannot be swiped together.

programmes.name: Sasol Rewards
programmes.headline: 30 points/litre
programmes.condition: Free registration; single-account fuel earning is capped at 100 litres in 24 hours. Rand conversion was not confirmed, so the calculator shows points.

programmes.name: Nedbank Greenbacks
programmes.headline: 25c/litre equivalent; BP combination up to 45c/litre
programmes.condition: Pay with an eligible Greenbacks-linked card. Nedbank uses inland ULP 95 to calculate litres, even for other fuel. BP Rewards is a separate balance.

programmes.name: FNB eBucks
programmes.headline: Up to R8/litre for qualifying Premier/Private clients
programmes.condition: Up to R4 base + R2 eligible finance + R2 eligible insurance; virtual-card and nav»Car rules apply. Account spend limits and the insurance-premium cap reduce the maximum.

programmes.name: Standard Bank UCount
programmes.headline: Up to R10/litre
programmes.condition: Top credit-card tier with double earn. All qualifying card/POS and fuel-spend conditions, a current account and two other qualifying product categories apply. Evolve has lower rates.

programmes.name: Absa Rewards
programmes.headline: Up to 30% at tier 5 with a credit card
programmes.condition: Tier 5 debit earns 4.5%. The partner allowance is R3,000 monthly, including relevant store purchases. Swipe V+ at Shell or Sasol Rewards at Sasol; Sasol points remain separate from the cashback total.

programmes.name: Discovery Insure Vitality Drive
programmes.headline: Up to 50%; maximum R1,500/month
programmes.condition: Eligible insurance plan, sensor, card swipe and driving status. Points limit qualifying fuel/Gautrain spend; cashback cannot exceed the relevant vehicle premium excluding VAT. Core Plan has no fuel rewards.
programmes.reward: Cash or Discovery Miles, depending on arrangement

programmes.name: Discovery Bank Vitality Money
programmes.headline: Up to 20% through October; up to 15% from 1 November 2026
programmes.condition: Qualifying bank product, activation, status and spend rules. Enter the actual percentage and remaining limits in your app; bank membership alone does not establish a rate.
